obT1: What tools does your team use?
obS1: Select the ones you want to connect.
aiH: Opens your AI chat (Claude, Copilot or Antigravity) with context loaded.
clCp: Click a suggestion to copy and paste in your AI chat.
testS: AI generated automated tests. You can also test manually.
revS: Add screenshots and comments to Jira.
mrMsg: MR created. Ticket moved to "In Review". Pipeline handles deploy.
envS: Launch local databases and services on your machine in 1 click.
docInstDesc: Docker allows you to run databases (Postgres, MySQL) and your app locally without manual config.
docNotRunDesc: Docker is installed on your Mac but the app is not open.
aiHubS: Connect your preferred chat. When working on tickets, context and prompts open directly in your assistant.
aiActLbl: Active assistant for tickets and prompts
addedTestToast: 2 automated tests & new screenshot added with AI
addedSsToast: New automated screenshot generated by Playwright
startLocallyDesc: Work on your machine without Jira or external tools. Create epics, stories, and commits 100% locally in your folder.
initGitBtn: Initialize Git in this folder (git init)
noGitFolder: No Git repository detected in this project folder.
localCommitMsg: Changes saved to local commit. Task completed.
noWorkspaceCommit: No workspace folder is open, so nothing was committed. Open a project folder in VS Code and try again.
noWorkspaceBranch: No workspace folder is open, so Product Studio did not create a branch.
noGitRepo: This folder is not a Git repository. Initialize Git before creating a branch or commit.
gitInitOk: Local Git repository initialized. No files were committed.
gitInitOkNoIdentity: Local Git repository initialized. Set your Git name and email before the first commit (git config --global user.name and user.email), or set them for this repository when you commit.
missingGitIdentity: Git has no user.name or user.email for this repository. Nothing was changed. You can set them globally in a terminal, or set them for this repository only.
gitIdentityHowTo: Set your identity with: git config --global user.name "Your Name" and git config --global user.email "you@example.com".
gitNamePrompt: Git user.name for this repository only
gitEmailPrompt: Git user.email for this repository only
gitIdentitySaved: Git identity saved for this repository only.
dirtyWorktree: You have uncommitted changes. Commit them on the current branch, or stash them, before switching to {branch}. Product Studio will not discard your work.
dirtyCommitPrompt: Commit message for the changes already in this folder
nothingToCommit: Nothing to commit. Change some files and try again.
commitNoRemote: Commit created ({hash}) on {branch}. No Git remote is configured, so it was not pushed.
pushFailed: The commit was created ({hash}), but the push failed: {error}
invalidTicketId: That ticket id cannot be used in a Git branch or commit.
invalidTitle: The commit title is empty or not usable.
invalidContainerId: That container id was rejected, so Docker was not called.
branchCancelled: Stayed on {branch}. No files were discarded.
stashPopFailed: Your changes are still in the stash. git stash pop reported: {error}
planIntro: Describe the idea in your own words. AI will suggest epics and tasks. You can edit everything before saving.
planIdeaPh: Example: a small app where neighbors share tools...
planNoModel: No local AI model is available in this editor. You can still create the plan yourself.
planModelError: The AI model did not return a plan. You can try again or create the plan yourself.
planRegenAsk: Regenerating replaces the edits in this draft. The saved plan is not changed until you save.
planInvalid: This plan cannot be saved yet.
planNeedTitles: Add a title for the plan, every epic, and every task.
planCorrupt: The saved plan file is damaged, so it was not changed. Fix .product-studio/plan.json or move it aside.
planSaveError: The plan could not be saved in this folder.
noWorkspacePlan: Open a project folder before saving a plan.
planOutside: That file is outside the open folder.
planFileType: Choose a markdown or text file from this folder.
